comment: The revert-checks of the question predicate (issue #243): every reader takes the escalation's `**The decision:**` line, and only a comment without that marker falls back to its first non-empty line. The escalation comment opens with its verdict word, so the fallback alone answers `needs-decision` and an answer binds to `<!-- answers: needs-decision -->` — measured on #196's own answer. One mutation per implementation, because the shell readers share one jq program and the Java core restates it: A1.1 mutates the program in `tools/issues/lib.sh` (read by `decisions.sh` and `answer.sh`), A1.2 the restatement in `WorkPackage.java`. A2.1 and A2.2 are the park lane (issue #845), one mutation per invariant: the outcome that writes no state, and the queue entry that says what a park waits for instead of the question it settled. A3.1–A3.3 are the park's own mark (issue #859), which is what tells the queue a statement is a park rather than an answer the filing path recorded: the mark written, the mark required, and the bound question printed for an answer without it. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/issues/tests/decision-question-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how and `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule.

mutations.label: A1.1
mutations.why: the marker line being the question — without it the first non-empty line is the escalation's verdict word

mutations.label: A1.2
mutations.why: the same rule in the work package's fallback, which the answer's marker now makes rare but not absent

mutations.label: A2.1
mutations.why: a park writes the answer and performs no transition — without the empty arm the item leaves the queue it must stay in

mutations.label: A2.2
mutations.why: the queue prints what a park waits for, not the answer's own first line where the question stood

mutations.label: A3.1
mutations.why: the mark only a park writes (issue #859) — without it the comment is the answer's shape and the queue cannot tell a park from a filed finding's recorded answer

mutations.label: A3.2
mutations.why: the predicate requiring the mark as well as the shape (issue #859) — without it an answer the filing path recorded prints `parked: …` although nobody parked it

mutations.label: A3.3
mutations.why: the question an answer binds being printed for an answer without the mark (issue #859) — without it the answer's own first line stands where a question belongs
